name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover emergency storm damage repairs?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover emergency storm damage repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental damage caused by perils like wind, hail, and falling objects (such as trees) during a storm. However, coverage details, deductibles, and specific exclusions can vary significantly. It's essential to review your policy or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage. City Dweller, LLC can assist with documentation and provide estimates to help facilitate your insurance claim process, but we recommend you confirm coverage with your insurer first.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance typically covers storm damage, but policies vary. Review your policy or contact your insurer for details on coverage and deductibles. City Dweller, LLC can help with documentation for claims.
